checks.details: The loopback control API returned HTTP 202 for one check-engine command and queued it to the exact installed native backend.
The same receipt-bound backend process generation existed before initialization and after the terminal idle status; no retry or replacement occurred.
The resident launcher observed terminal phase initialized, finalized the generation, and authoritative health reported engine_probe_state passed.
The backend returned to idle with run_state false, plan_active false, and no live run session.
The resident launcher logged initialized finalization and removed the engine receipt, cancel receipt, and native command file.
The installed runtime event delta contained exactly engine.check.started sequence 1 and engine.check.passed sequence 2.
The already attached BlueStacks, ADB, and visible Clan Castle-selected Home state were unchanged across the check; balances were unchanged and no new ADB process or gameplay event appeared.
The external profile, installed English, and saved run-plan integrity digests were unchanged; the plan file predates the engine check.

notes: Exact-current evidence for managed-engine initialization only. It proves no-input engine readiness and supervisor cleanup while BlueStacks was already attached; it does not prove recognition, battle, training, donation, upgrade, account, or other gameplay behavior.
